title: Listen to live blues in Clarksdale

location.label: Ground Zero Blues Club, Clarksdale, Mississippi

description: Spend an evening at Ground Zero Blues Club in Clarksdale, in the Mississippi Delta where blues history runs deep. Order something to eat, find a place near the stage, and settle into a live set. The point is to hear today’s musicians in a town that still treats the music as a living practice.
teaser: Make time for a live blues set in the Mississippi Delta.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm the band, seating and sound levels before traveling.
whyItMightDelightYou: Hearing the music where its roots are so present gives the evening a sense of place.
